hypothesis: The unchanged pooled ETH compression-pullback route may add portfolio cadence if a source-compatible prospective window produces attributable, technically resolved long and short lifecycles with positive after-cost economics that do not depend on one winner.
decision: Continue the isolated report-only observer unchanged. Do not add ETH, relax an entry condition, retune a parameter, or infer signal cadence from repeated minute evaluations.
why_this_revision: The first cutoff-bound evidence now quantifies readiness depth. It is technically complete, but no evaluation exceeded one of three entry conditions and no short-side evaluation occurred.

interpretation.current_evidence: The observer is functioning, but the first 39 post-cutoff evaluations did not contain a fresh breakout onset or prior compression. Repeated minute rows describe one short market window and are not independent setups.
interpretation.comparison_with_no_action: Keeping v53 unchanged remains preferred because the ETH observer has not produced a qualifying counterfactual entry or resolved lifecycle.
interpretation.minimum_update_evidence: At least one source-attributable eligible event on each configured side with complete decision, book, stop path, exact costs, and resolved lifecycle evidence. Any approval-ready recommendation must remain positive after removing its largest winner.

risks_and_failure_modes: Thirty-nine minute evaluations cover less than one hour and cannot validate or falsify a weekly cadence estimate.
All observed evaluations were long-side, so bidirectional behavior is untested.
Historical edge is small, selection-sensitive, and largest-winner dependent in the opened final block.
An eligible observer signal is not an executable result until its causal risk and cost path resolves.
Changing a filter during this window would invalidate the preregistered comparison.
